display_long_description:
Pulse Blade VR is a fast, neon rhythm slasher for Meta Quest. Wield an energy blade in each hand and carve through streams of glowing notes in time with the music — red notes for your left blade, blue for your right — slicing in the direction the arrows point while you dodge the bombs.

Every clean cut builds your combo multiplier (x1 to x8) and lights up the arena. String together full-combo runs, chase precision "Perfect" cuts for bonus points, and survive as your energy gauge drains on every miss.

FEATURES
- Two-handed energy-blade slashing with directional cuts and precision scoring
- Three difficulties (Easy / Normal / Hard) from gentle warm-ups to dense, bomb-laced charts
- A dark neon arena: Tron-style grid, glowing gateway, pure-black void
- Combo multipliers, an energy/fail meter, and a per-track high-score chase
- Earn coins as you play and grow your run
- Built natively for Meta Quest with smooth, comfortable, stationary play

Grab the blades, feel the pulse, and slash to the beat.
